approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce strict status-filtered inventory questions falling through to bounded retrieval and model generation.
Use only explicit primary RFI/Submittal statuses in the complete cached terminal-run index; never infer status from relationship state or missing documents.
Require the status filter to apply to every requested workflow type; incompatible combinations stay on the evidence path.
Exclude identifiers with multiple explicit statuses from confirmed results and report matching conflicts separately as ambiguous.
Reuse bounded disposition equivalence and list ceilings; make no evidence retrieval, model request or budget action.
title: Answer explicit-status workflow inventory questions locally
objective: Answer common explicit-status RFI and Submittal inventory questions completely and locally while preserving every indexed status conflict.
